g.text: The Lead Frontier Architecture: Dual-Plane Volumetric Consensus Fusion, Boundary Continuity, and Outlier Suppression
Resampled Slices Orthogonal to Acquisition (Slow Y-Z Axis)
Fast inference; ideal for low-VRAM edge clinical nodes
Current best research performer (Median MABE 4.71 µm)
Transposes vertical tensor back to standard (Z, Y, X) space
Cancels out inter-B-scan steps and false positives
• Surface-Guided Clamping: Drops FP below RPE (2.0 px)
• Optic Cup-Reach Tracking: Accurately stops at cup rim
• Native OS Orientation: Flips OS laterality correctly
HELD-OUT VALIDATION EVIDENCE: BIPLANAR 2.5D VS OTHER APPROACHES
